name: Citrusdal Mountain
terroir: Piekenierskloof is a high mountain ward on the N7 between Citrusdal and Clanwilliam, its old bush vines planted on sandy loam at 620-780m — among the highest-altitude vineyard sites in the Western Cape. Grenache Noir is the ward's signature old-vine variety.
